name: Functional Correctness
description: Build clean (bun build). Tests pass (bun test). Auth, device CRUD + provisioning, hawkBit operations, deployments, artifacts all functional. Device delete = unclaim (hawkBit target preserved). Deprovision = permanent removal (super admin only). hawkBit sync engine guards on hawkbitConfig.enabled. Background sync worker runs on interval.

name: Code Quality
description: Every file under 250 lines. Clean separation: schemas.ts (types) → index.ts / routes.ts (handlers) → service.ts (logic) → hawkbit client (adapter). No inline response schemas in route files — all imported from schemas.ts. Logger uses %s format strings (never pass unknown/number as second arg).

name: Schema Organization
description: Each module's schemas.ts owns all body, response, and shared param schemas. ErrorResponseSchema and GenericActionResponseSchema in common/schemas, re-exported by each module. Route files NEVER define response schemas inline. Params/query schemas may live in schemas.ts or locally in route files.

name: Error Handling
description: hawkBit errors isolated — never leak API paths or request IDs. HawkbitApiError wraps external failures. Sync catches errors silently. Deprovision catches hawkBit delete failure gracefully (target may not exist). Pino uses %s format strings for type-safe logging.

name: Test Coverage
description: 9 test files + test-helpers.ts covering auth, devices, deployments, artifacts, categories, companies, health, posts, provisioning. Tests validate auth (superAdmin macro), authorization, validation, CRUD, hawkBit endpoint structure. Separate test DB (Neon). afterAll() cleans all tables via cleanAll(). Idempotent runs.

name: Config Centralization
description: ALL config flows through env.ts (TypeBox validated). SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS for platform admin. HAWKBIT_AUTOPROVISIONING flag. HAWKBIT_SYNC_INTERVAL_SEC/STALE_SEC for sync tuning. Zero process.env reads outside env.ts (except migrate.ts). .env, .env.example, .env.test kept in sync.

name: Security
description: Super admin via SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS env var (superAdmin macro). Company RBAC via companyRole macro (owner/admin/operator/viewer). Device removal from company = unclaim (hawkBit preserved). Only DELETE /deprovision/:sn (super admin) removes from hawkBit. hawkBit guard on all external calls. deviceKey never stored in DB.

name: 🔮 Futuro (Aprendizado Contínuo)
description: 42 principles in .harness/principles.json covering architecture, security, testing, process, quality. SKILL.md updated with current state. Key patterns: unclaim vs deprovision, superAdmin macro, test DB isolation, background sync architecture.
